justification: User-facing FAQ text only (no logic, queries or schema): removes hand-typed planning figures and unsourced comparisons from the granny-flat council FAQ data, and prunes the matching figure-ledger entries. Standard, not Minor, because the text is live, indexed planning information; not Critical because no computed verdict changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: none (static FAQ strings in a TypeScript module)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A page renders a FAQ field the rewrite removed -> tsc catches it; 0 errors
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All 24 council pages on the next deploy

functions.name: GRANNY_FLAT_LGA_SLUG_MAP
functions.output: lga.faqs rendered by the /granny-flat/<council> page as a FAQ list and FAQPage JSON-LD
functions.if_none: faqs is required by the type; tsc fails the build if a council loses it

break_it.scenario: An answer still states a figure the scanner does not recognise (e.g. spelled-out numbers)
break_it.how: grep for digits in granny-flat-lgas.ts: only heritageCount fields and '2021' remain; spelled-out figures checked by reading the diff
break_it.what_happens: the rewritten answer would still state a hand-typed number

break_it.scenario: An answer tells a user a DA is available where the zone prohibits a secondary dwelling
break_it.how: Sol cross-review flagged it; every 'If any check fails' answer now says a DA may be possible unless the zone prohibits it
break_it.what_happens: wasted DA cost on development that cannot be approved
break_it.repro: open /granny-flat/ku-ring-gai and read 'Do I need council approval'
break_it.mitigated: answers now say a DA may be possible unless the zone prohibits a secondary dwelling

break_it.scenario: An answer says all acid sulfate land is excluded, wrongly failing a Class 3-5 lot
break_it.how: Sol cross-review flagged it; answers now say some acid sulfate soil classes are excluded and the class on the map decides
break_it.repro: open /granny-flat/randwick and read the acid sulfate answer
break_it.mitigated: answers now say only some classes are excluded and the class on the map decides

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any planning figure is typed back into granny-flat-lgas.ts: it is no longer in the ledger, so the scanner reports it as unlisted and exits non-zero (the 58 pruned entries also make the open cap 437, so re-adding them as open fails too)
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-23: put '450 m²' back into one Campbelltown answer -> scanner printed 'NOT IN LEDGER (new typed figure): frontend-nextjs/lib/lga-data/granny-flat-lgas.ts::...450 m²...'; file restored after
